At second station conveyor carries pale ivory-green vanilla orchid flowers (long narrow petals, tubular pale yellow lip), fairy transfers orchid to funnel. At third station cart carries transparent pale cyan floating air orbs filled with light mist, fantasy game visualization of ozonic accord, no brown sugar or crystals; fairies tilt cart and glowing airy spheres float into hopper. Central mixing chamber becomes warm pale ivory-gold, not pink. Keep the same miniature whimsical factory visual quality, fairy bellflower hats and wings, intricate brass and emerald machines, realistic shadows/reflections, smooth movement without stutter. Final delivery door opens to reveal exact reference yellow perfume bottle already standing opaque, with exact label GUCCI FLORA GORGEOUS ORCHID attached from first visibility, moving physically on conveyor through clear doorway, no teleportation, no morphing, no label overlay entrance. No UI or titles; those added later. No pear, gardenia or brown sugar anywhere.

No movie characters or copied sets. 0-3s camera smoothly flies through emerald entrance revealing three connected factory stations at different heights, multiple fairies bustling at work. 3-8s pear station: two pink fairies physically roll ONE oversized pear onto a brass plate. At 5.5s a fairy pulls a large lever, flower-shaped press descends onto pear, pale green juice visibly flows through transparent spiral pipe; mechanical action is clear and coherent. 8-13s camera tracks a moving conveyor of white gardenia flowers; at 11s ivory fairy taps the fully open bloom, a brass scoop gently transfers that whole flower into a glass extraction funnel, gold particles flow along the second pipe. 13-19s camera follows a small mine cart on brass rails at FLOOR LEVEL filled with small brown sugar crystals; two green fairies push it to a weighing hopper, at 16.5s fairy pulls lever, cart tilts and same small crystals tumble into hopper; no giant sugar boulders, no sugar on flowers. 19-24s all three pipes visibly connect to large central glass blending machine; a pink fairy swings on valve handle and opens three valves sequentially, ingredients swirl into pale blush liquid, gears turn, three lamps illuminate, steam puff signals completion. 24-27s camera tracks DOWN AND FORWARD to a clearly separate little delivery doorway in the lower front of machine. Solid emerald door swings aside revealing an ALREADY COMPLETE OPAQUE bottle standing upright on a brass conveyor INSIDE the dark compartment. Conveyor physically carries bottle forward through open doorway into open air, correct clearance, bottle never intersects glass or metal. Bottle must NOT appear inside mixing tank, must NOT materialize, fade in, grow or transform; label attached from very first visible frame. 27-30s camera smoothly approaches bottle on conveyor, label faces camera frontally, exact GUCCI FLORA GORGEOUS GARDENIA original product design; fairies hover on either side without obscuring bottle. All movement smooth, no duplicate freeze frames, no camera jumps. Keep top 11 percent quiet for HUD added later. No rendered UI, no text except actual product label, no speech. Continuous playful elegant celesta and pizzicato music, gear clicks, glass chimes, satisfying mechanical sounds synchronized to levers and magical completion chime. Music resolves at end.
